in_marathi.name: Riteshkumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's name, rule, or God of death
in_marathi.long_meaning: Riteshkumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ritesh (Ri-tesh) is a Sanskrit name that is derived from the Sanskrit word 'rit' which means 'right' and 'to rule'. Kumar is a Sanskrit name meaning 'son of'. So, Riteshkumar can be interpreted as 'son of the one who rules right'. This name is often given to babies born in Hindu families.
